findings: Both retained CSV coefficient ratios exactly reproduce final cells of the corresponding MAT matrices.
Each saved original model has propeller positions matching rounded final grid coordinates.
Each shell driver identifies the model, V=50, shared engine1power330, alpha1.05 or4.2, and NODE I150.
remaining_gaps: The commented MATLAB generator requests Var11/Var17 but the retained CSV has four columns; exact producer/exporter-version correspondence remains unresolved.
Three temp.txt outputs differ from same-prefix CSVs and remain unpaired targets.
Saved models alone do not prove all intermediate grid model bytes or historical atmosphere/PG/KF/pose defaults.
MAT ratio precision is not original coefficient printing precision; ratios must not be used to invent lost CL/CD target columns.
